def feats(g,ans):
    res=[]
    for o in sorted(objects(g,T,T,T), key=lambda o:ulcorner(o)):
        si,sj=ulcorner(o); h,w=shape(o); pat=crop(g,(si,sj),shape(o))
        cells=len(o)
        f=dict(shape=(h,w),bbox=h*w,cells=cells)
        f['v']=all(r==r[::-1] for r in pat)
        f['h']=pat==pat[::-1]
        f['180']=pat==tuple(r[::-1] for r in pat[::-1])
        f['d']=tuple(zip(*pat))==pat
        # holes: zeros not connected to border (4-conn)
        seen=set(); 
        import collections
        for st in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if pat[i][j]==0 and (i in(0,h-1) or j in(0,w-1))]:
            q=collections.deque([st]); seen.add(st)
            while q:
                i,j=q.popleft()
                for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    a,b=i+di,j+dj
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and pat[a][b]==0 and (a,b) not in seen: seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
        f['holes']=sum(1 for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if pat[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen)
        f['fullrow']=sum(1 for r in pat if 0 not in r)
        f['fullcol']=sum(1 for c in zip(*pat) if 0 not in c)
        res.append((f, (si,sj), pat==(tuple(map(tuple,ans)))))
    return res
